description: Reviewed public facts from the official GES website. Saved locally; no visitor-time requests. Reverify roles on the linked official pages when updating.

facts.title: Global Education Services (GES)
facts.answer: Global Education Services (GES) is an Omani private education group founded in 2012, providing K–12 schools, preschools and early learning centres.

facts.title: Shomoukh and GES
facts.answer: GES lists Shomoukh Early Childhood Education’s Al Qurum and Al Mouj campuses among its education institutions, with links to shomoukh.com.

facts.title: Sheikh Salim Hamood Al Hashmi
facts.answer: GES’s official website identifies Sheikh Salim Hamood Al Hashmi as Chairman.

facts.title: Education institutions listed by GES
facts.answer: The GES About page lists Al Shomoukh International Private School (SIPS), Shomoukh ECE Al Qurum Campus and Shomoukh ECE Al Mouj Campus. These are the institutions identified on this page; this is not a confirmed total for the group.

facts.title: Al Shomoukh International Private School (SIPS)
facts.answer: GES lists Al Shomoukh International Private School (SIPS) at Hay Al Hail, Al Jadeed Al Hail South, Muscat, Oman. Its profile states it was established in 2015 and offers the National English Curriculum (British) for K–12 students alongside a bilingual stream.

facts.title: Shomoukh ECE Al Qurum Campus — GES listing
facts.answer: GES lists Shomoukh ECE Al Qurum Campus at Al Saruj St., Shatti Al Qurum, Muscat, Oman, and describes its Reggio Emilia inspired curriculum. The local Shomoukh contact page supplies its detailed address and contact information.

facts.title: Shomoukh ECE Al Mouj Campus — GES listing
facts.answer: GES lists Shomoukh ECE Al Mouj Campus in Al Mouj, Muscat, Oman, with a link to the Shomoukh website. Its profile describes early childhood education and sustainable initiatives.

facts.title: GES vision
facts.answer: GES states a vision of developing innovative leaders who contribute to society and thrive globally.

facts.title: GES mission
facts.answer: GES describes its mission as providing education that encourages curiosity, lifelong learning, individual potential and a positive contribution to the world.

facts.title: GES values — ELEVATE
facts.answer: GES names its ELEVATE values as Excellence, Leadership, Equity, Vision, Adaptability, Technology and Empowerment.

facts.title: GES published school count
facts.answer: The GES homepage displays a count of four schools. Its About page names SIPS, Shomoukh ECE Al Qurum and Shomoukh ECE Al Mouj. The reviewed pages do not identify a fourth institution, so ask GES to confirm the complete current list. Shomoukh Nursery itself has two published Muscat campuses.

auditNotes: Local public contact details are more specific than GES campus descriptions. Al Saruj (GES) and Al Suraj (local site) are recorded as source spelling variants, not different campuses.
GES describes Qurum ages one to four; local eligibility claims range from three months to six years. Admissions confirmation remains necessary.
GES About identifies three named institutions, not a verified total of all GES schools. No schedules or contacts for SIPS or the GES group are published on the reviewed About page.
